raw_response:
This season I am hoping my FISP coupon comes through like last year, because without the subsidy the fertilizer prices at the market are too much for me. If I get the coupon I will put the NPK and urea on my maize, but I have to spread it across the whole plot since 1.36 hectares is bigger than what the two bags are meant for. I also keep some manure from the chickens and the goat pen which I put in the planting stations before the rains. I am intercropping with pigeon pea and beans as I always do — they help the soil and give us something to eat if the maize is poor.

For the seed, I will buy the hybrid if the FISP pack has it, but I may mix in some seed I kept from last year because the hybrid packet is not enough for the whole plot. I cannot afford pesticide and we have no river close enough to irrigate, so I will weed by hand with my children. I may pay a few young men for ganyu during the ridging because my back cannot do all of it alone.
